name: scroll-area
useFor: Use for a panel with its own scroll (a list of sites or counties, the sources of an answer, a row of tags) inside a fixed-height layout. Give it a height (h-72, flex-1 in a column). Add a horizontal ScrollBar for wide content. Its edges fade (fade-xy) where more content scrolls past them, either way; nothing is cut off by a hard edge.
constraints: Nested scroll areas in the same direction
Hiding the bar entirely on desktop
source: Not in Figma: Stone and Slate from the product greys (442:2), for a designer's review
title: Scroll Area
description: A region that scrolls inside the page with a thin square Stone bar that steps to Slate under the pointer.
